title: Selling Plans — Volume Window for Discount Dispute Credits and FBN Enrollment
content:
**Rule.** The fee basis behind the volume bonus of a discount dispute credit on **Selling Plans** is measured over the volume window: the long volume window when the seller's FBN enrollment is active and holds at least the large FBN stock of units on hand, the FBN volume window when the FBN enrollment is active and holds fewer units than that, and the standard volume window when the seller has no active FBN enrollment; the window takes the variable final value fee records billed within that many whole months before the decision date.

The enrollment read is the seller's Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment: its status and the units on hand it shows.

## The window by enrollment

| Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment | Units on hand | Volume window |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 500 or more (the large FBN stock) | Long volume window: 6 whole months |
| Active | Fewer than 500 | FBN volume window: 3 whole months |
| No active enrollment (none, or an enrollment in any status other than active) | Any | Standard volume window: 1 whole month |

The window takes the variable final value fee records billed within that many whole months before the decision date.

## Both sides of the stock threshold (hypothetical enrollments)

| Enrollment status | Units on hand | Window |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 500 | 6 whole months — 500 is at least the large FBN stock |
| Active | 499 | 3 whole months — fewer than 500 |
| Winding down | 2000 | 1 whole month — the enrollment is not active |
